title: WorldBuilder.Terminal Agent API Schema
description: Machine-readable schema for the WorldBuilder.Terminal JSON-line protocol. An AI agent can load this at startup to discover available commands, required/optional parameters, and response shapes.

requestFormat.description: One JSON object per line on stdin. Must contain a 'command' field.

responseEnvelope.description: Every response contains 'success' and 'command'. Failures include 'error'.

coordinateSystem.description: Right-handed coordinate system. X = East, Y = North, Z = Up.

load.description: Load a .wbproj project file. Must be called before terrain/object commands.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to a .wbproj file

export.description: Export modified DAT files to a directory.

info.description: Show info about the currently loaded project.

smooth.description: Smooth terrain heights within a radius by averaging neighbors.

raise.description: Raise terrain height indices within a radius.

lower.description: Lower terrain height indices within a radius.

set-height.description: Set all vertices within a radius to an exact height index.

paint.description: Paint terrain texture type within a radius.

type.description: Terrain type index (use get-region to see available types)

fill.description: Flood-fill contiguous terrain of the same type from a seed point.

type.description: New terrain type to fill with

road.description: Draw a road path between two world positions following terrain-aware routing.

get-height.description: Query terrain height and vertex metadata at a world position.

terrain-info.description: Statistical summary of a landblock's terrain data.

get-heightmap.description: Full 9×9 height grid for a landblock in both world and index form.

get-terrain-data.description: Complete per-vertex data for all 81 vertices in a landblock.

list-objects.description: List all static objects in a landblock.

add-object.description: Place a new static object in a landblock.

snap.description: Snap position to nearest outdoor cell center

remove-object.description: Remove a static object by index. WARNING: Indices shift after removal.

move-object.description: Move a static object to a new world position.

rotate-object.description: Set an object's orientation. Provide EITHER quaternion (qw/qx/qy/qz) OR yaw (degrees). This SETS the orientation absolutely — it does not compose with existing rotation.

yaw.description: Z-axis rotation in degrees (alternative to quaternion)

orientation.description: Must provide EITHER all quaternion fields (qw,qx,qy,qz) OR yaw

query-radius.description: Find all static objects within a radius of a world position. Searches across landblock boundaries.
query-radius.notes: Objects sorted by distance (nearest first). modelFrequency sorted by count (descending).

analyze-dungeons.description: Scan all dungeon cells in loaded DATs. Produces room type catalog and starter candidates.

outputPath.description: File path to save full report JSON

get-dungeon-info.description: Get full cell layout of a dungeon within a landblock.

validate-dungeon.description: Validate dungeon structural integrity. Diagnostic codes: DNG001-DNG011.

validate-landblock.description: Validate landblock static objects. Diagnostic codes: LBK001-LBK009.

validate-terrain.description: Validate terrain data. Diagnostic codes: TRN001-TRN005.

cliffThreshold.description: Height delta for cliff warnings (world units)

validate-building-portals.description: Validate building portal links. Diagnostic codes: BLD001-BLD008.

validate-all.description: Run ALL four validators in one call. Recommended validation command for agents.

list-landblocks.description: List landblocks with terrain data in a coordinate range.

get-region.description: Height lookup table and terrain type names from the game's Region data.

response.heightTable: float[] (indexed 0-255, maps height index to world height)

extract-cell-footprints.description: Extract per-cell wall polygons + portal wall-spans for every cached dungeon document. Cells with missing Environment entries fall back to a synthetic AABB. Filtered re-extracts merge with the existing cache rather than overwriting.

lbFilter.description: Restrict to specific landblocks (hex strings like '0xA9B4' or numeric ushorts). Without this, every dungeon doc in the project is processed.

generate-object-sprites.description: Render top-down ortho sprites for every model id placed in the project, with texture-based albedo + Lambert shade matching render-preview's hillshade. Outputs per-sprite PNGs, a packed atlas.png, and manifest.jsonl.

spritePx.description: Pixels per longest world dim. 256 = quick test, 512 = production.

render-dungeon.description: Per-floor interior renderer. Reuses LandblockDescriber.ClusterByCellZ for the floor partition (top-down ordered, floor 0 = highest Z). Draws cell-fills with per-floor hue family, walls, portal classification (same-floor gap / cross-floor amber / exterior green), and cell-resident + LB-doc loose objects via the sprite atlas if loaded.

floor.description: Floor index (0 = top). Omit for an all-floors render with hue distinction.

emit-tile-pyramid.description: Standard Leaflet z/x/y pyramid generator. Renders each LB once at the deepest zoom (LbPx = 256 * 2^(maxZoom-8)), slices into 256x256 tiles, then 2x2 mitchell-downsamples to fill lower zooms. Optionally emits a sprite-mode object tier and per-LB-per-floor dungeon image overlays.

dirtyOnly.description: Reuse the tile cache's DirtyLbs set populated by OnTransactCommitted for incremental re-renders.

describe-floor.description: Per-floor variant of describe-landblock. Returns cell count, Z band, cell-resident object count, loose objects in band, and a one-line verbal summary specific to the floor.

emit-static-site.description: Orchestrator that composes extract-cell-footprints + generate-object-sprites + emit-tile-pyramid + describe-landblock + describe-floor + gazetteer-driven overlays + the vendored Leaflet frontend bundle into a self-contained dist/ folder. Multi-project: a second invocation with a different projectSlug into the same outDir merges into manifest.js rather than wiping it.

projectSlug.description: Identifier under projects/<slug>/ in the dist tree.

outDir.description: Top-level dist root. Will be created if absent.

import-render-surface.description: Imports a PNG to replace a RenderSurface (default: register in CustomTextureStore; ui:true: deferred portal write).

name.description: Display name; defaults to image filename stem

import-heightmap.description: Imports a heightmap+colormap PNG over a landblock grid (height from luminance, type from nearest texture-color).

creature-get.description: Loads ACE-DB creature visual overrides (texture map, anim part, palette).

creature-save.description: Replaces texture-map + anim-part rows for the given object_Id (transactional).

creature-export-sql.description: Generates idempotent DELETE+INSERT SQL for the creature's overrides.

ace-db-ingest-creatures.description: Pulls every WeenieType=10 row from the connected ACE DB and writes a CreatureRecord array to creature_gazetteer.json.

ace-db-ingest-npcs.description: Pulls Vendor (20) + Talker (4) weenies from the connected ACE DB to npc_gazetteer.json.

ace-db-ingest-housing.description: Reads house_portal rows from the connected ACE DB to housing_gazetteer.json (flat array of portal records).

ace-db-ingest-spawns.description: Bulk-reads landblock_instance and writes per-spawn SpawnRecord JSONL. Records without a roster join are flagged isSynthetic:true.

compare-creatures-to-retail.description: Jaccard similarity of project's spawn gazetteer vs. ACE creature/NPC/housing rosters. Cheap to call from the ML loop.

spell-list.description: Lists newest spell ids by source ('dat' default, 'db' for ace-db); annotates rows that have a project overlay.

spell-get.description: Returns a SpellRecord JSON; project overlay wins, falls back to ace-db.

spell-save.description: Writes a SpellRecord into the project overlay; if ace-db is connected also UPSERTs the row.

spell-copy.description: Clones a spell with a new id (auto-allocates max+1 if newId is omitted).

spell-delete.description: Removes a spell from the project overlay; if ace-db is connected also DELETEs the row.

weenie-save.description: Replaces all scalar weenie_properties_* rows for an existing class_Id.

weenie-insert.description: Creates a new weenie row (auto-class-id ≥100000) and saves the snapshot scalars.

weenie-delete.description: Deletes a weenie + every weenie_properties_* row that points at its class_Id.

placement-list.description: Lists outdoor/dungeon instance placements (filtered by lb + kind).

placement-add-outdoor.description: Appends an outdoor instance placement to Project.OutdoorInstancePlacements.

placement-add-dungeon.description: Appends a dungeon instance placement to the dungeon document for the given lb.

placement-remove.description: Removes an outdoor or dungeon placement by index in its respective list.

placement-export-sql.description: Writes landblock_instances.sql + dungeon_instances.sql; --apply runs them against ace-db.

layout-list.description: Lists every LayoutDesc id from the local DAT (or only ones with a project overlay).

layout-get.description: Returns a LayoutDesc as JSON; preferred from project overlay if present.

layout-save.description: Saves a JSON LayoutDesc into the project's LayoutDatDocument overlay.

layout-delete-overlay.description: Removes the project overlay for a LayoutDesc id (DAT original is untouched).

fresh-start.description: Wipes all terrain to deep sea + deletes all dungeon documents (requires confirm:true).

confirm.description: Must be true; safety gate against accidental destruction

generate-world.description: GUI-parity world generation: ResetWorldDocs → terrain → buildings → decorations; optional CSV emit.

params.description: WorldGeneratorParams shape (seed, biomes, town count, etc.)

export-towns-csv.description: Renders the GUI's towns CSV from a worldgen result JSON written by generate-world.

open-log-folder.description: Returns the active --log-file path so the agent can ingest it (no folder-opening side effects).

help.description: Returns the command list as structured JSON.

quit.description: Terminate the JSON session. Process exits after sending response.

transact.description: Stage N mutating ops, validate the staged delta, atomically commit or rollback. Allow-list: terrain edits, object placement, generate-dungeon, paste-stamp.

ops.description: Inline list of op objects (each shaped as a normal JSON command).

opsFile.description: Path to a JSON file holding either a top-level array of ops or { "ops": [...] }. Use when the inline payload would exceed stdin line-buffer limits.

rollback_on_fail.description: If true, restore pre-state on any op failure or validation error.

diff.description: When set, returns transact-diff in the same response. Values: true | "structured" | "visual" | "both".

renderMode.description: Visual diff mode when diff includes visual: overlay | side-by-side | after-only-with-diff.

response.ops: object[] (per-op outcome with embedded inner response)
response.diff: transactDiff? (present only when 'diff' was requested; same shape as transact-diff response)

transact-diff.description: Structured before/after report for a previously committed transact. Reads pre+post projection snapshots retained in an LRU keyed by transaction id; nothing is persisted to disk.

txId.description: Transaction GUID returned by a prior transact response.

render.description: Also return a visual diff PNG.

lbs.description: Restrict diff to specific [lbX, lbY] pairs. Default: all touched LBs.

out.description: Write the visual PNG to this path; the response then carries outPath instead of pngBase64.

response.terrainSummary: object? (only when batch touched terrain doc with no specific landblocks; biome histograms + per-vertex change counts)

visual.note: string? (info-level message, e.g. 'terrain-only batch — no landblocks specified')

validationReport.description: Uniform response shape for all validation commands.

DNG006.description: Environment ID not found in DAT

DNG008.description: Portal polygon ID not in CellStruct

LBK008.description: Model ID not found in DAT

TRN002.description: Extreme height cliff between adjacent vertices

TRN005.description: Edge height mismatch with neighbor landblock

BLD004.description: EnvCell has no outdoor exit portal
